t: Libya Counting on Strategic Partnership With Russia - Presidential Council Head
d: Chairman of the Libyan Presidential Council Mohammad Al-Manfi said on Tuesday that his country expects to develop a strategic partnership with Moscow.

t: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro Flees to US
d: Former Brazilian presidential candidate and right‑wing politician Flavio Bolsonaro has fled the country.

t: Iran Urges Europe to Stop Whitewashing US's Broken Promises
d: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei has called on European nations to stop shielding the United States from accountability, following President Trump's admission that he "never believed" in their ceasefire agreement.

t: Russia Calls Germany's Lack of Response to Nord Stream Bombing ‘Disgrace’
d: Germany's decision to remain silent following the bombing of the Nord Stream and Nord Stream 2 gas pipelines is disgraceful, Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Alexander Grushko said in an interview with Sputnik.

t: Lula da Silva Slams Brazilian Presidential Candidate Bolsonaro for Departure to US
d: Re-elected Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has called the departure of presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro to the United States shameful and disrespectful toward voters.

t: No Violation of Silence Regime in Alyoshki for 30 Hours - Russian Ombudswoman
d: There have been no incidents of any violation of the silence regime in Alyoshki for 30 hours, Russian Human Rights Commissioner Yana Lantratova said on Wednesday.

t: Russian Forces Liberate Barilovka in Sumy Region and Alisovka in Kharkov region – MoD
d: Russian Forces have liberated Barilovka in the Sumy region and Alisovka in the Kharkov region, according to the Russian Defense Ministry.

t: Trump Says Talks With Putin, Zelensky May Not Be in Person
d: US President Donald Trump said that potential trilateral talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelensky would not necessarily take place in person, but assured that the meeting would happen soon.

t: Russia's Arctic Advantage Opens Door to US Cooperation, but Sanctions Remain Obstacle
d: While the current geopolitical environment presents challenges to attracting US investment into Russian Arctic projects, certain potential for partnership remains, expert Irina Strelnikova told Sputnik.

t: Iran, Russia Preparing Document on Joint Construction of Small Nuclear Power Plants - AEOI
d: Iran and Russia are preparing a document providing for the joint and accelerated construction of small-capacity nuclear power plants, Behrouz Kamalvandi, spokesman for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI), said on Wednesday.
